name: Dining and tea furniture sections
prompt:
Create ONE detailed GAME FURNITURE COMPONENT REFERENCE SHEET. Title INT-DINING-FURN-001 — MODULAR DINING & TEA FURNITURE. Exactly FOUR clean spacious cells, large three-quarter view of ONE isolated object per cell, small FRONT, SIDE, TOP and REAR/CONTACT or UNDERSIDE views of the SAME object. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, no room, humans, flowers, fabric or table settings. Supplied GEN-24 gives the existing palace furniture language: ivory/rose marble, crisp gold lotus/rose/star detailing, slender feet, indigo accent insets. Do not reproduce furniture already present on source. Dimensions are PROPOSED. Full IDs and names outside silhouettes. Main requirement: S01 and S02 are two DIFFERENT joinable table sections, not two complete tables. True flat joining planes, no molding across cut ends, same top and apron thickness. Small assembly diagram may show centre plus TWO COPIES of S02; don't label copies as separate models. Contacts remain visible, no hardware obscuring seams. Footer: Proposed component references; physical joins, underside topology and view parity require modeling review.

INT-DINING-FURN-001-S01 — Dining table straight centre. Proposed W,D,H [2, 2.2, 0.76]m. A RECTANGULAR straight centre module for an oval table, 2m width,2.2m length,0.76m height. Rose/ivory marble top, fine gold perimeter only along the TWO LONG SIDE EDGES, four slender lotus legs with open space beneath. BOTH SHORT ENDS are precisely STRAIGHT flat joining planes, no rounded cap, decorative hanging piece or gold lip across joining edge. Top height and apron section must match S02. Show a dashed assembly guide with one S02 attached to each short end, forming ONE2x4.2m oval table. This small guide is not a fifth asset.

INT-DINING-FURN-001-S02 — Dining table semicircular end. Proposed W,D,H [2, 1, 0.76]m. ONE HALF-DISC rounded table end module, straight diameter back edge2m wide, semicircle depth1m, tabletop0.76m above ground. Two legs near the OUTER CURVED edge; NO leg or back panel on the straight joining plane. Same marble thickness, gold rim and apron as S01. Main image shows semicircle clearly, not a full oval table. Top view is an exact half-disc with straight diameter; front/contact view shows plain cut edge and underside connector seats. Only OUTER curve has gold apron. NO raised lip along joining back. Duplicate and rotate this same module for both table ends.

INT-DINING-FURN-001-S03 — Tea conversation table. Proposed W,D,H [1, 0.65, 0.72]m. ONE small oval tea table, 1mx0.65m footprint,0.72m high. Ivory/rose marble top with modest gold-star inlay, gilt floral apron, four slender legs. Human proportions, clean empty top, no tea service or chair because existing dressing is reused. Complete oval top; this is not a joinable end cap.

INT-DINING-FURN-001-S04 — Display sideboard. Proposed W,D,H [1.8, 0.5, 1.1]m. ONE low display sideboard, ivory body, rose-veined marble top, gilded rose/star door frames and indigo inset strips. Three shallow drawers above enclosed cupboards. Main view closed; rear view plain timber panel and a small open state shows shelves. No attached giant mirror, wall, gifts, candles or flower arrangement.

proposed_join_contract.facing_end_profiles: must be modeled and fit-tested; image is not proof

visual_review_notes: All four intended furniture types are present. S01 has a rectangular central top with exposed straight cut edges; S02 has a semicircular end with a straight diameter. Assembly guide shows centre plus two copies of the end. Human-scale dimensions and palette follow the proposed contract.

S02 main and contact views show two legs, but its small underside view appears to add extra corner legs. The two-leg declaration and main view control the intended end module; underside image is not reliable topology.

S01 front view draws a decorated apron across a cut end even though the main view leaves a plain joining face. Remove any transverse apron or cap from both centre cut ends during modeling. Exact seam profiles, rim alignment and material continuity require fit testing.
Only short S01–S04 suffixes are printed under the full sheet ID; full component IDs are indexed in metadata.
